title: crepis senecioides subsp. filiformis
intro: Crepis senecioides subsp. filiformis, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) and is native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to alleviate various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting digestive health, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's therapeutic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
